svg.title: SE 423: Introduction to Mechatronics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
svg.desc: Isometric illustration of the SE 423 mechatronics lab. Two lab partners at a workbench program the red TI LaunchPad F28379D on its green breakout board from a laptop; the board's LEDs show 423 in binary. One partner points at the class robot car, which carries the same board, a camera, motion-capture markers and a LiDAR whose scan hits the plywood arena walls. The robot follows an A-star path around a divider to an orange golf ball. A whiteboard shows a PWM signal and a PID feedback loop.
